description: Convert one or more policy documents into a sealed NOMOS governance artifact (.nomos). Extracts executable rules using Claude, detects contradictions between rules, computes an Autonomy Readiness Index (ARI) score (0–1), and cryptographically seals the result. Returns an artifact_id you can use with verify_decision immediately. Optionally accepts historical behavioral decision logs to add a behavioral evidence layer and reach CERTIFIED confidence tier.

behavioral_logs.description: Optional historical decision records (CSV rows as objects) for behavioral triangulation. Minimum 10 rows recommended.

items.description: One row of historical decision data as a key/value object.

documents.description: Policy documents to extract rules from. Each item must have filename and content (plain text).

content.description: Plain text content of the document.

filename.description: Original filename including extension (e.g. "credit-policy.pdf"). Used for provenance tracking.

source_type.description: Document type hint for extraction heuristics. Defaults to "policy".

domain.description: Industry or domain hint (e.g. "lending", "hr", "e-commerce", "healthcare", "insurance"). Improves extraction accuracy.

name.description: Human-readable name for the governance artifact (e.g. "Loan Approval Policy v2", "HR Leave Rules").

organization.description: Name of the organization this artifact governs (e.g. "Acme Bank", "HealthCorp").

name: generate_governance

ari_score.description: Autonomy Readiness Index 0–1 (≥0.60 autonomous, ≥0.30 bounded, <0.30 human-governed)

artifact_id.description: Unique ID for the sealed artifact — use this with verify_decision

seal_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic seal of the artifact
